purpose: Archive-exposed computation benchmark using the identical original and reduced certificate with physically nonnested moving queries. Tuning was allowed on the public fixed observations, and this is not a blind inference study.
query_family: Distinct triples within a small local neighborhood. Two cells keep their exact midpoint and shrink width. The third widens the parent interval. Every query has a different changed support and is neither a subset nor a superset of the parent or another query.
